html:
Given distinct positive candidate integers and target >= 0, return all nondecreasing combinations summing to target, in lexicographic order. Candidates may be reused. Target 0 has one empty combination.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      2,
      3,
      5
    ],
    7
  ],
  "expected": [
    [
      2,
      2,
      3
    ],
    [
      2,
      5
    ]
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      4
    ],
    3
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Restrict the next index to avoid generating different orders of the same combination.

Complexity: Exponential time/output in target; O(target/min_candidate) recursion depth when nonempty
